title: Beautiful Feet on the Hills
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who finds something wonderful and cannot keep it to himself, and tonight is about carrying good news: Isaiah's runner brings peace over the mountains, and Scout runs to every table and out to the parking lot to tell his mom the hamster had babies.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because good news is meant to be carried, not kept. In Scout’s world today: Scout found out the classroom hamster had babies. He could not hold it in for one second. He ran to every table in the room, and then straight out to the parking lot to tell his mom. Just like the runner on the mountains, Scout learned that happy news grows bigger when we share it.
